newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan teenager killed for cigarettes worth $1.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan teenager killed for cigarettes worth $1.

text.p: A Moroccan student killed a teenage hawker in eastern Morocco in a row over cigarettes worth $1, a newspaper said on Tuesday.

Police arrested Abdelali Lashkham, an Islamic studies student, after he stabbed to death cigarette seller Mohamed Ben Azouz, 17, who refused him credit for nine cigarettes worth nine dirhams ($1), L'Opinion said.
Lashkham could face the death penalty, lawyers said. The newspaper said the killing occurred in the city of Oujda, near Algeria's border, but gave no other details.
